newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises FTSE 100 target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises FTSE 100 target.

text.p: Strategists at BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Plc, raised their year-end targets for the UK's FTSE 100 index to reflect recent gains in UK equities on the back of strong gilts, market sources said on Monday.
The brokerage increased its end-1996 target to 3,900 from 3,750 and increased its end-1997 target to 4,300 from 4,150, sources said.
However BZW's end-1996 forecast for the FTSE is below the index's current level and the brokerage warned that the recent gilt market advance could have run its course.

BZW strategists also said UK markets could come under pressure in the run-up to the UK general election which must be held by next May -- and is likely to be followed by tighter fiscal and monetary policy.
BZW strategists were not immediately available for comment.
At 1231 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 6.0 points at 4,034.1, some 13 points below its record 4,046.8 set October 7, but up 345 points or 9.3 percent on its level at the end of 1995.
